steps.title: How to install
steps.windows.1: Download the .zip file with the button above.
steps.windows.2: Right-click it, choose Extract All, and open the folder it makes.
steps.windows.3: Double-click Install {app}.cmd. A black window shows the progress and closes by itself.
steps.windows.4: {app} opens. Next time use its icon on the Desktop or in the Start menu, or the Open from device button on this page.
steps.mac.1: Download the .zip file with the button above. Safari opens it for you; in other browsers double-click it in Downloads.
steps.mac.2: Right-click Install {app} and choose Open, then press Open again.
steps.mac.3: A message says when it is installed. {app} opens in its own window; its icon is in your Applications folder.
steps.mac.4: Next time use that icon, or the Open from device button on this page.
warn.windows: Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) because we do not pay for a publisher certificate. Click More info, then Run anyway. The file is the one on this page; its checksum is under Other devices.
warn.mac: macOS may say it cannot check the app for malware, because we do not pay for an Apple developer certificate. Right-click > Open (as in step 2) is the normal way through. On the newest macOS: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
limits.title: Honest limits
limits.unsigned: The installers are not signed with a paid publisher certificate, so Windows and macOS show a warning the first time. The steps above say what to click.
limits.updates: To update, install again from this page: it always gives the latest version. Automatic update notices inside the app work on computers that can reach our update service.
limits.data: Your files and settings stay on your computer. Uninstalling the app keeps them.
others.title: Other devices and checksums
others.unsupported: Linux is not supported yet. Windows on ARM is not tested.
phone.title: On a phone: companion app
phone.lead: {app}'s real tools (disks, recovery, repair, scans) need a Windows PC or a Mac, so they cannot run on a phone. What you can install here is a small companion that shows the latest version and what is new. It never claims to protect your phone.
phone.install: Install the companion on this phone
phone.ios: On iPhone / iPad: tap the Share button, then Add to Home Screen.
phone.share: Send this page to my computer
phone.copied: Link copied. Paste it on your computer.
phone.android: On Android: open the browser menu and choose Install app / Add to Home screen.
